items.title: Volcano eruption leaves 170,000 passengers stranded in Indonesia
novel_facts: Stranded passenger count updated from 150,000 to 170,000
Airport closures updated from six to eight
Airports to remain closed until 09:00 local time Monday
New resident quote from Aldi Candra Prayogi describing eye irritation
items.reason: This is the same volcanic eruption event (Anak Krakatau) affecting the same airports, reported by the same source, with updated and higher casualty/impact figures (170,000 vs 150,000 stranded passengers, eight vs six airports, 1,558 vs 467 flights delayed) plus a specific reopening timeline. These are material updates that revise the scale of disruption but do not introduce a distinct accountability or policy angle warranting a separate story.

items.title: Europe has its first commercial orbital rocket
items.reason: Both articles report the identical event: Isar Aerospace's Spectrum rocket successfully reaching orbit from a Norwegian spaceport, Europe's first fully commercial orbital launch, referencing the same CEO quote and prior March failure. The incoming article contains no new facts beyond what the canonical already covers; it is a shorter, less detailed version of the same story.
